adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Adenosine activates A1 receptors in AV nodal tissue, increasing potassium conductance and reducing calcium-dependent nodal depolarization. Hyperpolarization transiently blocks AV conduction and terminates AV node-dependent reentry.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Adenosine reduces cAMP and calcium current as well as increasing potassium efflux. The keyed option intentionally includes both hyperpolarizing K efflux and reduced Ca influx, making it more complete than any alternative.
